sentences.text:
(Presently Lodged At Central Jail, Sri Ganganagar)
 ----Petitioner  Versus  1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  2. Ranjeet Singh S/o Lakhya Singh, R/o 16 Ml Khayaliwala,
 Sriganganagar.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : None present For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, PP
HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 21/03/2023 1.
The lawyers are abstaining from work on account of strike.

2. The present application for bail has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with FIR No.50/2022 registered at Police Station Sadar, District Sri Ganganagar for the offences under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(D), 376(2)(N) IPC and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station Sadar, District Sri Ganganagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3. None present on behalf of the petitioner.
4.
Learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application.

He submits the prosecutrix was about seventeen years at the time of incident and, in her statements, recorded under Section 164 CrPC, she stated that she went with the petitioner as per her own free will.

5. Heard and perused the material available on record.
Pinku vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/007127) on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190816285/
1 [2023/RJJD/007127] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-12813/2022]
6.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case as well as the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 CrPC and without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case and the fact that the trial of case is likely to take a long time, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.
7. Consequently, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that petitioner Pinku S/o Late Sh. Jageswar, shall be released on bail in connection with the aforesaid FIR; provided he executes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court.
The petitioner shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(DR.NUPUR BHATI),J SURABHII/169- Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
